assertions.description: The system-level 'network {}' block has zero generator consumers on any platform and was deleted from the config model; no example may reintroduce it. Anchored to system level -- a block directly inside the config, 'base' or a 'profile' (at most 4 spaces under the config-linter's 2-space layout) -- so a platform's own 'network {}' setting (e.g. platforms.azureVm.network, 8 spaces deep), which is live config, is not matched.
